summary.fr: Assistance et diagnostics Dell (pilotes, analyses, envoi d'informations au support).
summary.en: Dell support and diagnostics (drivers, scans, sending information to support).

avance.fr: Plusieurs services selon les versions (SupportAssistAgent, Dell Client Management Service, Remediation).
avance.en: Several services depending on version (SupportAssistAgent, Dell Client Management Service, Remediation).

ifDisabled.fr: Mises à jour de pilotes Dell et diagnostics automatiques indisponibles
ifDisabled.en: Dell driver updates and automatic diagnostics unavailable
